content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to set a unique ID number for communication between a Modbus TCP Server [product_name] and a Modbus TCP Client? I am using four [product_name] modules set up as Modbus TCP Servers, all connected to a Moxa Gateway that connects to an RS485 Modbus Server PLC. I am currently facing issues with the ID numbers. Thank you.
The ID number is determined on the server side; the [product_name] does not control this setting. To find the slave address the server uses, you should consult the server's documentation.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is uncertain about how to assign a unique identifier for Modbus TCP Server communication when using multiple [product_name] devices on the same network. There is a lack of straightforward guidance and configuration options within the product interface. ID assignment is dictated solely by the server, which limits user flexibility and understanding.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to assign a unique ID directly on each [product_name] device to simplify identification within the communication network.
